title: 第14章 镖局第15章 确定离开
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
带着对修仙有望的欢喜，林鹤清渐渐睡去，因为他实在太激动了，没法进入心无旁骛的修仙状态。
第二天一早，林鹤清醒了。
按照计划，他今天应该去看书，但是他现在无心看书，只想着要怎么才能去找到地图，或者知道通往斜阳县的路往哪走。
地图这条路应该不好走，因为舆图在古代，是有军事用途的，要是随随便便给人看了，万一有奸细把消息传递出去了，城防容易被破。
此路不通，那就只能看看哪里有消息灵通的商人或者镖局了，这两类人经常走南闯北，有可能会知道斜阳县。
所以今天吃了饭以后，肖力和肖强就发现，自家主子怎么不按之前的习惯去书肆看书，反而走向良泉县的西南方向。
那里可是贫民区，里面鱼龙混杂，什么人都有，小偷小摸更是稀疏平常，看来今天的差不好当啊。
两人跟在林鹤清后面，眼睛紧紧盯着他，不敢叫他一刻不在自己眼中。
林鹤清也不是瞎逛的，那种一看就是农户卖自家东西的，他也不会往前凑。
终于他的脚步停下了，停在了一个写着“走南闯北”的摊子后面，摊子上有一个身材高大的男人坐在里面，正在给人介绍。
“客人，我们这忠义镖局真的是最便宜的了，别的镖局要带人去南丰国至少是要三十五两银子才行的，您还得自己自带干粮马车。
哪像我们这里，只要三十两，吃住都可跟我们的镖车，这可是打着灯笼也找不着的好事呢”。
那男人口若悬河，滔滔不绝，正对着一个看起来是个有点小钱的小商贩说道。
商贩虽然想去南丰国，但是还是知道平时的价钱的，“之前一直都是一辆车五十两包吃住，现在怎么只要三十两了？”
“你不会是把我骗上车，然后杀人夺财吧？”那男人狐疑，不敢相信他。
“怎么会呢，只是我们五天后要出发去南丰国接一趟镖。
但是这里去南丰国的人还太少了，眼看着就要空车了，我们镖头才说可以便宜呢？真的是再划算不过了。”
“我再想想，你别扒拉我，我再想想！”
“好吧”，那高大男人放下手，“那您要快点想啊，我们这趟镖五天后是肯定会离开的，过了这个村就没有这个店了噢”。
“我知道，我再回去想想。”商贩回道。

林鹤清只是站了片刻，不动声色，听见了他们谈话，就往前走了。
前头还有两个镖局，镖局里是不缺人的，大多是需要走远的商人还有需要寄包裹的人，个别人是自己需要去远的地方，请个镖师保护自己。
“兴隆镖局”里，人来人往。
林鹤清走了进去，刚一进去，就有一个小二过来请林鹤清进去一个小房间。
这个门店后面的一圈屋子都被分割成多个小房间，用来保护隐私。
“您先坐，过一会儿就有人过来了”，小二说完，就离开了。
这生意太好了，不抓紧的话，一会吃不了午饭了。
“好。”
过了大概一刻钟，来了一个二十多岁的青年。
“客人好，我是兴隆镖局的镖师，我叫尚武，来迟了请您见谅。您是想？”那青年口齿伶俐，吐字清晰。
“我是想问你们最近有没有去南丰国的镖？”林鹤清直截了当地问。
content_en:
With joy at the prospect of cultivating immortality, Lin Heqing gradually fell asleep, because he was too excited to enter the state of cultivating immortality without any distractions.
Early the next morning, Lin He woke up.
According to the plan, he should read a book today, but he has no intention of reading now. He only thinks about how to find the map or know where the road to Xieyang County is.
Maps should be a difficult road to follow, because maps were used for military purposes in ancient times. If they were shown to others casually, if a spy spread the news, the city defense would be easily breached.
If this road is blocked, then you can only look where there are well-informed businessmen or escort agencies. These two types of people often travel far and wide, and they may know about Xieyang County.
So after eating today, Xiao Li and Xiao Qiang discovered why their master did not go to the bookstore to read as usual, but instead walked to the southwest of Liangquan County.
It was a slum area, a mixed bag of people, and petty theft was rare and common. It seemed that today's difference was not good.
The two of them followed Lin Heqing, staring at him closely, not daring to keep him out of their eyes for a moment.
Lin Heqing wasn't just shopping around. He looked like a farmer selling his own goods, so he wouldn't move forward.
Finally, he stopped and stopped behind a stall that said "Walking Around". There was a tall man sitting inside the stall, introducing people to him.
"Guest, our Zhongyi Escort Agency is really the cheapest. For other Escort agencies, it costs at least thirty-five taels of silver to take someone to Nanfeng Country. You also have to bring your own rations and carriage.
It’s not like here, where for only thirty taels, you can have food, accommodation and food with our escort car. This is a good thing that you can’t find even with a lantern.”
The man was eloquent and gushing, and he was talking to a small vendor who looked like he had a little money.
Although the vendor wanted to go to Nanfeng Country, he still knew the usual price. "Before, it was 50 taels per car including food and accommodation. Why is it only 30 taels now?"
"You didn't trick me into getting into the car, and then killed people and took money, right?" The man was suspicious and couldn't believe him.
"How could it be? It's just that we have to leave for Nanfeng Country to pick up an escort in five days.
But there are too few people going to Nanfeng Country here, and the trains are about to be empty. Why did our escort chief say we can get cheaper? It really couldn't be a better deal. "
"I'll think about it again, don't push me, I'll think about it again!"
"Okay", the tall man put down his hand, "Then you have to think quickly, our escort will definitely leave in five days. After passing this village, there will be no shop like this."
"I know, I'll go back and think about it later," the merchant replied.
Lin Heqing just stood for a moment, calmly, heard their conversation, and walked forward.
There are two escort bureaus ahead. There is no shortage of people in the escort bureaus. Most of them are businessmen who need to go far away and people who need to send packages. Some people need to go to far places by themselves and hire an escort to protect them.
In the "Xinglong Escort Bureau", people come and go.
Lin Heqing walked in. As soon as he entered, a waiter came over and asked Lin Heqing to enter a small room.
The circle of houses behind the store is divided into multiple small rooms to protect privacy.
"You sit down first, someone will be here in a while," the waiter said and left.
This business is so good, if we don't hurry up, we won't be able to have lunch for a while.
"Okay."
About a quarter of an hour later, a young man in his twenties came.
"Hello guest, I am an escort from the Xinglong Escort Bureau. My name is Shang Wu. Please forgive me for being late. What do you want?" The young man was articulate and spoke clearly.
"I want to ask if you have any escorts who have been to Nanfeng Kingdom recently?" Lin Heqing asked bluntly.
